title: Knowing When to Ask for Help: Bayesian Self-Escalation in Hierarchical LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.24087v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Current LLM agent systems decide delegation before reasoning begins (a router picks a model) or after a response is complete (a verifier scores it and may retry). We study a third regime: an agent that recognises, during its own reasoning, that it is unlikely to succeed and transfers control to a stronger model. We formulate intra-generation delegation as a Bayesian optimal-stopping problem over a learned competence posterior -- an online estimate of the agent's eventual task success whose sufficient statistics are learned from labelled trajectories, not read off raw entropy. We derive the myopic escalation threshold in closed form, characterise the optimal policy via dynamic programming, and prove that the optimal policy is a time-varying threshold with no shape assumption on the raw signal. translated_title: 知道何时求助：分层LLM代理中的贝叶斯自我升级
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24087v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：当前的LLM代理系统在推理开始前决定委派（路由器选择模型）或在响应完成后决定委派（验证器评分并可能重试）。我们研究第三种机制：代理在其自身推理过程中，认识到自己可能失败，并将控制权转移给更强的模型。我们将生成过程中的委派形式化为一个贝叶斯最优停止问题，基于学习到的能力后验——即对代理最终任务成功的在线估计，其充分统计量从标记轨迹中学习，而非直接读取原始熵。我们以封闭形式推导出短视升级阈值，通过动态规划刻画最优策略，并证明最优策略是一个时变阈值，无需对原始信号做形状假设。我们进一步证明了在Chernoff信息速率下预言机信念的指数分离，以及由校准性支配的遗憾界。
tldr: 本文提出一种新机制，让LLM代理在推理过程中实时评估自身成功概率，并在低置信时自动升级到更强模型，通过贝叶斯最优停止理论实现高效且可证明最优的委派。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel mechanism where LLM agents evaluate their own success probability during reasoning and escalate to stronger models when uncertain, using Bayesian optimal stopping theory for efficient and provably optimal delegation.
